disclaimer: All environmental figures are prototype estimates based on peer-reviewed LCA literature and require institutional verification.

laptop_embodied_co2e_kg.source: Fraunhofer IZM / Dell Product Carbon Footprint Reports (Provisional meta-average)
laptop_embodied_co2e_kg.notes: Estimated manufacturing and distribution carbon footprint of a standard 14-inch business laptop.

desktop_embodied_co2e_kg.source: European Commission JRC ICT LCA Review (Provisional benchmark)
desktop_embodied_co2e_kg.notes: Estimated embodied carbon for standard enterprise desktop chassis (excluding standalone display).

laptop_ewaste_mass_kg.source: Typical chassis mass measurement without external power brick
laptop_ewaste_mass_kg.notes: Average net e-waste diversion weight for business laptops.

desktop_ewaste_mass_kg.notes: Average net e-waste diversion weight for desktop mini-towers.

annual_operational_co2e_avoided_kg_per_y.notes: Annualized displaced new equipment manufacturing carbon footprint per year of extended active lifetime.
